summary: Park Ha Biological Technology filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 Regulation S private placement to non-U.S. investors, not a special situation. The company sold 1,080,000 Class A ordinary shares at $2.75 per share plus warrants for 1,845,452 shares, raising roughly US$2.97 million gross before expenses; warrants are immediately exercisable for five years at US$1.10 per warrant share, each covering 2.5 shares, with customary anti-dilution. Proceeds fund general working capital. Watch warrant overhang and potential dilution, not deal arbitrage.
